# Three.js

Vendored Three.js 0.160.0 (MIT), unmodified classic browser build.

- Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/build/three.min.js
- License: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.0/LICENSE (included)
- Only loaded when the player-eye viewer opens. No runtime CDN request.
- Served and cached by the existing same-origin versioned-static service worker.
